advertisement.title: Business software built close to the work.
advertisement.body: We design tools around how African businesses actually operate.

siteCopy.aboutHeroTitle: We turn useful ideas into focused software.
siteCopy.aboutHeroIntro: Synteone comes from synthesis and one. We bring many ideas into one company, then give each product the focus it needs to become useful and trusted.
siteCopy.aboutRegisteredText: We are registered in Rwanda and building for African markets.
siteCopy.productsHeroTitle: We build products when the problem is clear.
siteCopy.productsHeroIntro: We create focused software products for teams that need clearer, more confident ways to work.
siteCopy.homeWhatTitle: We build around the way our customers actually work.
siteCopy.homeWhatBody: We are a business software company. We build one focused product at a time, starting with the problems African businesses and individuals face every day.
siteCopy.homeWhyTitle: We build close to the market we serve.
siteCopy.homeWhyBodyOne: Our customers need software that respects local operating realities, customer behavior, payment habits, and trust gaps.
siteCopy.homeWhyBodyTwo: We compete on trust and genuine relevance, not on being the cheapest option.
siteCopy.homeVision: To be known for solving real problems well - one at a time, one company at a time.
siteCopy.homeMission: We build focused software that solves real problems and makes everyday life easier, starting in Africa and expanding internationally.
siteCopy.homeValues:
Innovation
Integrity
Customer Focus
Excellence

Sustainable Growth
siteCopy.homeProjectsTitle: Our current work lives in one place.
siteCopy.projectsHeroTitle: We will share our products when they are ready.
siteCopy.projectsHeroIntro: We share current and upcoming work when it is ready for customers, partners, and the market.
